currentParagraphText: “I return that question to you. Are you willing to kill anyone and everything standing in your way to get a Truesoul you have no use for? Simply to deny us having it?”

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “I return that question to you. Are you willing to kill anyone and everything standing in your way to get a Truesoul you have no use for? Simply to deny us having it?”
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Whatever happens is not on me,” Jake simply spoke, not going to get dragged into that logic. They had already established that the Holy Church was the one that had stolen the Truesoul in the first place. Jake wasn’t going to feel bad for whatever happened next.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “You’re seriously willing to let that many people die for a gamble you have no way of winning?” Jake asked, thinking that now the god in front of him was the one being wholly unreasonable.
